Privacy Statement

To use this platform, the system writes one or more cookies in your browser. These cookies are not shared with any third parties. In addition, your IP address and browser information is stored in server logs and used to generate anonymized usage statistics. Phoenix Public Library uses these statistics to gauge the use of library content, and the information is not shared with any third parties.
